title: WDF Core 0.1 — ai/outline.json
description: Ordered structure map of the document: one node per citable element, in document order (WDF Core 0.1 §ai-layer). Node ids MUST be unique and MUST match the id attributes in content/index.html; uniqueness and cross-references are enforced by the validator, not by this schema.

id.description: Stable element id: type prefix + slug or counter (e.g. sec-introduction, p-0012, tbl-spesa-2025).

level.description: Heading level; present if and only if type is "heading".

parent.description: id of the containing node, or null for top-level nodes.
